descriptionChirho: A valley or ravine, used both as a common noun for geographic lowlands and in construct chains as part of proper place names (e.g., Valley of Hinnom, Valley of Salt); all 6 languages consistently translate with a single lexeme (eng 'valley', spa 'valle', hin 'घाटी', arb 'وادي', kor '골짜기/계곡', swa 'bonde') across singular, plural, definite, construct, and prepositional forms, confirming a single semantic sense.
